verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static-site framework, so whether it ships official SDKs is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents one. It shows only npm-installable plugins, a pluggable React architecture and swizzling, which are framework extension points rather than an official SDK, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or API surface to build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
